subject.title: feat(apps): add native mobile Automations parity

question: Should the focused mobile Automations management surface and the folded post-merge Skills corrections land together once the exact-head native gates pass?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and well-proven, but it establishes a sizable native product boundary and combines an adjacent merged feature's corrections; automation cannot decide whether that combined scope is the intended review and release unit.

options.title: Approve the combined native scope
options.body: Land Automations parity and the bounded Skills corrections together after iOS, Android, and cron owners approve the state model and exact-head native checks pass.

options.title: Split the Skills follow-up
options.body: Move the Skills corrections to a narrow follow-up PR so this PR contains only the Automations product surface and localization generated from it.

options.title: Narrow Automations further
options.body: Keep only naming, search, and filtering now, and defer iOS editing, run tracking, history, and deletion until the native state model receives separate product approval.

recommendation.title: Approve the combined native scope
recommendation.body: Land Automations parity and the bounded Skills corrections together after iOS, Android, and cron owners approve the state model and exact-head native checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the listed product lead, authored the linked product direction, and merged the adjacent native Skills feature included in this branch.
